name: pos_x
doc: Absolute world x of the scene's top-left corner, in pixels

name: pos_y
doc: Absolute world y of the scene's top-left corner, in pixels

name: material_filename
doc: Material image (.png or .plz) whose colours become cell materials. May be empty when just_load_an_entity is used

name: colors_filename
doc: Visual image laid over the materials

name: skip_biome_checks
doc: Place the scene even where the biome does not match

name: skip_edge_textures
doc: Skip edge-texture generation around the scene

name: just_load_an_entity
doc: Entity file to spawn at pos_x/pos_y instead of (or as well as) stamping images

name: clean_area_before
doc: Erase the scene's rectangle before stamping it
